title: Astronomy Shop overview
description: Is the Astronomy Shop healthy: traffic, orders and payments, its database, and what its logs and traces say.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Requests per second the shop answered at its front door, the Envoy proxy.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of the proxy's requests whose span ended in an error.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile time the proxy took to answer a request.

panels.title: Orders placed
panels.description: Orders the checkout service placed, per minute.

panels.description: Services that sent spans in the last minutes.

Payment charges per minute by outcome
Buffer cache hit ratio by database

queries.query: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(SeverityText, 'err') > 0, 'error', positionCaseInsensitive(SeverityText, 'warn') > 0, 'warn', 'info') AS severity, count() AS lines FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

panels.title: Log lines and errors by service

queries.query: SELECT ServiceName AS service, count() AS lines, countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(SeverityText, 'err') > 0) AS errors FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY service ORDER BY errors DESC, lines DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, concat(ServiceName, ': ', Body) AS Body, TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName != 'otelcol-contrib' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95 FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'product-catalog' AND SpanName = 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slowest requests at the front door

queries.query: SELECT Timestamp AS time, TraceId AS trace_id, Duration / 1e6 AS duration_ms, StatusCode AS status FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend-proxy' ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: How are requests and load spread out?
Database connections in use
panels.description: Share of the database's connection limit held by sessions.

queries.query: SELECT Duration / 1e6 AS duration_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'product-catalog' AND SpanName = 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' LIMIT 5000

SELECT toFloat64(dateDiff('second', Timestamp, now())) AS seconds_ago, Duration / 1e6 AS duration_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend-proxy' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT toFloat64(intDiv(toUInt64(Duration / 1e6), 100) * 100) AS duration_ms, count() AS requests FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend-proxy' GROUP BY duration_ms ORDER BY duration_ms

panels.title: Product lookup time every 5 minutes
panels.description: Each candle is five minutes of product lookups: first and last duration, with the fastest and slowest as the wicks.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, toFloat64(argMin(Duration, Timestamp)) / 1e6 AS open, toFloat64(max(Duration)) / 1e6 AS high, toFloat64(min(Duration)) / 1e6 AS low, toFloat64(argMax(Duration, Timestamp)) / 1e6 AS close FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'product-catalog' AND SpanName = 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

(1 - sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[$__rate_interval])) > bool 0.01) + (1 - sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[$__rate_interval])) > bool 0.05)

panels.title: Where does a request spend its time?

queries.query: SELECT concat(p.ServiceName, ' -> ', c.ServiceName) AS id, p.ServiceName AS source, c.ServiceName AS target, count() AS mainstat FROM otel_traces AS c INNER JOIN otel_traces AS p ON c.ParentSpanId = p.SpanId AND c.TraceId = p.TraceId WHERE $__timeFilter(c.Timestamp) AND $__timeFilter(p.Timestamp) AND p.ServiceName != c.ServiceName GROUP BY source, target LIMIT 200

SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName, Timestamp AS startTime, Duration / 1000000 AS duration, SpanAttributes AS tags FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId = (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend' AND SpanName = 'POST /api/cart' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY startTime LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Where add-to-cart requests spend time
panels.description: The 100 latest add-to-cart requests merged by call path.

queries.query: WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend' AND SpanName = 'POST /api/cart' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100), t AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, concat(ServiceName, ': ', SpanName) AS label, Duration / 1e6 AS ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM roots)), tree AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, 0 AS level, label AS path, '' AS parent_path, label, ms FROM t WHERE ParentSpanId = '' UNION ALL SELECT t.TraceId, t.SpanId, tree.level + 1, concat(tree.path, char(1), t.label), tree.path, t.label, t.ms FROM t INNER JOIN tree ON t.TraceId = tree.TraceId AND t.ParentSpanId = tree.SpanId), agg AS (SELECT path, any(parent_path) AS parent_path, any(level) AS level, any(label) AS label, sum(ms) AS value FROM tree GROUP BY path) SELECT a.level AS level, a.value AS value, greatest(a.value - ifNull(c.child_value, 0), 0) AS self, a.label AS label FROM agg AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_path, sum(value) AS child_value FROM agg GROUP BY parent_path) AS c ON a.path = c.parent_path ORDER BY a.path

panels.title: Checkout flow
panels.description: Spans each service handled in the time range, drawn as the path a checkout takes.

queries.query: SELECT countIf(ServiceName = 'frontend') AS frontend, countIf(ServiceName = 'checkout') AS checkout, countIf(ServiceName = 'payment') AS payment FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.title: What else is around the shop?
Where the services run
panels.description: Spans per service in the time range. The shop runs on one host, so the places are only examples.

queries.query: SELECT ServiceName AS service, if(ServiceName = 'frontend', 51.5, 50.1) AS lat, if(ServiceName = 'frontend', -0.1, 8.7) AS lon, count() AS spans FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName IN ('frontend', 'checkout') GROUP BY service ORDER BY service

panels.title: About these panels
panels.content:
From **How are requests and load spread out?** down, this dashboard shows one panel of every type SlashObserve draws, on the Astronomy Shop's own data.

The news panel needs github.com on the outbound allowlist in Settings, and it says so until an Admin allows it.

Pick **Edit** on a panel to see its query and change its type.
